description: Each mutant plants ONE defect the rendered-layout gate exists to catch, and names the assertion that must object to it. Every one of these was written after the check it targets, so the manifest doubles as a record of what the gate is actually asserting rather than what it appears to.

mutants.name: DOC-SCROLL compares against innerWidth, the naive test
mutants.expect: the document is reported as scrolling sideways

mutants.name: the scroller exemption is removed, so carousels report
mutants.expect: clean @\d+: ZERO findings

mutants.name: the descendant dedup is removed, 17 rows for one defect
mutants.expect: exactly one culprit

mutants.name: hidden is treated like auto, clipping absorbed as if scrollable
mutants.expect: three cut-off runs reported

mutants.name: the opacity test is removed, a transparent catcher counts as cover
mutants.from: if (!(o.bgAlpha >= T.occluderMinAlpha || o.hasBgImage || o.hasBackdrop)) return false;
mutants.expect: clean @\d+: ZERO findings

mutants.name: inconclusive samples counted as measured
mutants.expect: clipped text is NOT also reported as occluded

mutants.name: the width-mismatch refusal is removed
mutants.expect: refuses when the resize did not take

mutants.name: the empty-harvest refusal is removed, an empty probe reads as a clean page
mutants.expect: refuses an empty harvest

mutants.name: the no-viewport-meta refusal is removed
mutants.expect: refuses a mobile width on a page with no viewport meta

mutants.name: a clipping ancestor no longer absorbs, the MDN false positive
mutants.expect: so it is NOT reported as an overflow culprit

mutants.name: clip-absorbed is folded into the rail count
mutants.expect: counted as clip-absorbed, apart from the rail case

mutants.name: control labels are no longer exempt, the Wikipedia false positives
mutants.expect: they are exempted, not reported|control-label exemption is inert

mutants.name: a text count with no input reports 0 rather than null
mutants.expect: the text-based counts are null, not zero

mutants.name: a pinned bar counts at every scroll position, sticky-header noise
mutants.expect: clean @\d+: ZERO findings|clean control still reports nothing

mutants.name: a pinned bar is exempt at EVERY scroll position, rest included
mutants.expect: an occlusion finding exists to inspect|and it is still reported

mutants.name: the probe stops reading the layout viewport
mutants.expect: re-capture the fixtures|the harvester in the tree right now

mutants.name: the probe measures element boxes instead of glyph boxes
mutants.expect: re-capture the fixtures|the harvester in the tree right now

mutants.name: the probe stops recording the control ancestor
mutants.expect: re-capture the fixtures|the harvester in the tree right now

mutants.name: the probe stops recording the occluder position
mutants.expect: re-capture the fixtures|the harvester in the tree right now

mutants.name: the coverage tally marks every text element, 100% forever
mutants.expect: re-capture the fixtures|the harvester in the tree right now|not marking nothing

mutants.name: the report drops the coverage denominator from the per-width table
mutants.expect: prints the coverage denominator|table row carries the denominator
